title: A lane or coordinator that takes or agrees to a departing pick cites the past rulings it checked
why:
The coordinator agreed at 07:59 CST Nov 8 to lane guard-relative-write-escape's pick (refuse a top-level `git -C` write into an agent worktree). Neither searched docs/decisions, and the pick contradicted owner rulings in decision agent-worktree-discard-is-noted. Review round 1 caught it (coordinator 08:24 CST; lane [ended:lane-guard-relative-write-escape] 08:23 CST). The past-ruling check (step question-checks-past-rulings, done) runs only on questions to the owner. INCIDENT 20:31 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 20:29, its own miss; triage read no page item itself): the coordinator took item 782's label-recommended option (a: drop the guard, close the stack's PRs) from its label, without reading the option text and without checking the item's answers doc, which held an owner answer act=park (19:21 CST Nov 13). Triage's fork caught it before any close; no PR closed, no branch moved. Guard idea (added to this step's scope): a pick filed on a page item is checked against the item's own answers doc and option text first: an owner park or answer on the item, a widens flag, or an option whose text the picker did not quote stops the pick and asks. First act for the lane: find where picks on page items are filed today (kin: past-ruling-on-send, consultant-go-reads-rulings, relay-ruling-matches-question) and put the check there; red then green: a pick on an item whose answers doc holds a park is refused. Rule: building-mistake-names-its-guard; one home (building-one-home-per-capability), so this extends the step and files no new one. LANE 23:27 CST Nov 14 (lane pick-ack-ruling-2, relayed data; PR #2932 draft): merged main locally at 68de8425dca6 (parents 62dd80d32b39, dc35317d3b40), not pushed. The records guard wants main's docs/records.md; pr-review-record's tree rule wants git's own result (the PR's 2 rows); the lane's commit follows the guard and would fail --fix-check. Asked the owner: page item 851 (pick-records-page-clean-merge-tree), a override one commit (lane's pick), b ask the merge-tool owner for a records-only exemption. No past ruling found. Lane waits. Also done by the lane: BRIEF_LINE in hooks/test_call_judge.py re-pointed red then green; 7 other test files pass; lint/test_hook_catalog.py fails 2 cases (the 2 missing records.md rows, rebuilt at merge). 00:53 CST Nov 15 (coordinator's pick, relayed, not the owner's, undoable): lane pick-ack-ruling-2 (PR #2932; GitHub read by triage: open draft, head b3285e30e588) takes the Call judge fixture suite off the code-only scope in checks.yml and the SCOPED lists in lint/test_checks_step_scope.py, because the new pick tests open the real brief template (skills/project-ops/templates/brief.md) at run time, so a template edit must rerun the suite. Not taken: widen ALLOWED (false for brief.md); test a fixture copy (drops the pick-free-template check). Cost: a brief-template edit reruns that suite. Ruling own-2932-scope-pick.

01:21 CST Nov 15, notes from lane pick-ack-ruling-2 (PR #2932, now with runner 10), relayed by the coordinator, not read in code by triage. Main-side home: docs/debts/notes.md (exists on main, 2283 lines); writing them there needs a PR. Debt note pick-brief-marker-backtracks is NOT on main (no hit in docs/), so 'extend' has nothing to extend yet.
Round-2 findings:
- re.M anchors unpinned.
- PICK_WORD backtracks quadratically on a 120 KB run of ". " (about 20 s).
- "I'm holding up PR 12" mid-sentence and after-colon forms pass.
- Rare false alarms: "Holding up well" and "Hold the meeting in room B".
- A hard-wrapped `hold the call at 3pm` plus newline passes.
- The `company` lookahead exempts every pick word (e.g. "picked company B").
Earlier notes:
- The refusal text at line 428 hints a reword bypass.
- `.md` is in PICK_PATH_REF.
- A bare "Coordinator's pick:" passes.
- lint/rule_mechanisms.json still says "a page item cite is unread".
Also: the lane's brief said the macOS row ran the suite on every change; wrong, macOS runs it only when checks_macos is true.
note: Merges the coordinator's pick-ack-past-ruling and the lane's pick-checks-owner-rulings, one incident. Scope: a pick a lane takes that departs from main, and a coordinator message that agrees to one, names the decisions it checked; the check asks when none is named. Candidate homes: the brief template and hooks/agent_brief.py, or the past-ruling search that question-checks-past-rulings built; the lane picks one and calls it, no copy. Done check: a red test where an agreement to a departing pick with no decisions named is asked. Build lane. Filed by triage 08:25 CST Nov 8. Started by the coordinator 08:27 CST Nov 8 in lane [ended:lane:-pick-ack-past-ruling]. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:lane:-pick-ack-past-ruling]). Plan R51 "A pick reads its ruling before it is sent" (owner approved 12:35 CST Nov 12; home decision session-tiers; restart-plan a2b2c8b). Owner 12:33 CST: "it's weird that ure making half-baked calls". Top of now: before the send, the check makes a coordinator pick cite a ruling or write "no ruling found: <search>". Joins the work of step past-ruling-on-send. Lane started by the coordinator 12:38 CST.
